Websites and software for different business types

Chronolyte scopes digital projects around each organization’s customers, workflows, and goals. The following examples are not a closed list.

Local service businesses

Cleaning companies, repair services, salons, pet care, and other appointment-led businesses.

Clear service pages, local search foundations, quote forms, reviews, and easy-to-use booking or contact flows.

Home services and trades

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, painting, and construction.

Service-area pages grounded in real operations, estimate requests, project galleries, and mobile-first calls to action.

Healthcare and clinics

Dental, medical, therapy, allied-health, and private practices.

Accessible service information, appointment enquiries, staff profiles, and careful handling of sensitive information.

Legal services

Law firms, attorneys, mediators, and specialist practices.

Practice-area content, attorney profiles, consultation requests, and clear disclaimers.

Accounting and financial services

Accounting firms, bookkeepers, financial advisors, and fintech teams.

Trust-building information, secure enquiry paths, client portals, and useful educational content.

Real estate and property

Brokerages, agents, property managers, developers, and mortgage teams.

Property discovery, search and filter tools, listing content, and enquiry workflows.

Retail and e-commerce

Online stores, independent retailers, direct-to-consumer brands, and marketplaces.

Product catalogs, checkout, inventory connections, customer accounts, and post-purchase communications.

Restaurants and food businesses

Restaurants, cafes, caterers, food producers, and delivery brands.

Menus, reservations or order enquiries, location details, and up-to-date hours and contact information.

Hospitality and travel

Hotels, venues, tour operators, and travel services.

Service and room details, availability enquiries, booking connections, and destination information.

Education and training

Schools, tutors, training providers, coaches, and online course creators.

Course catalogs, enrollment enquiries, learning portals, and clear schedules.

Manufacturing and distribution

Manufacturers, wholesalers, suppliers, and industrial companies.

Product specifications, quote requests, distributor information, and business-to-business catalogs.

Logistics and transportation

Freight providers, delivery companies, fleet operators, and mobility services.

Service-area details, quote and tracking integrations, customer portals, and operations dashboards.

Professional services and consulting

Consultants, architects, engineers, recruiters, and research firms.

Expertise pages, project examples, lead qualification, and scheduling workflows.

Insurance

Independent agencies, brokers, and insurtech businesses.

Coverage explanations, quote requests, secure customer access, and educational resources.

Automotive

Dealerships, repair shops, parts retailers, and vehicle services.

Inventory or service catalogs, appointment requests, financing enquiries, and location information.

Beauty, fitness, and wellness

Gyms, studios, spas, wellness practices, and personal-care brands.

Class or service schedules, membership details, booking paths, and mobile-friendly updates.

Nonprofits and community organizations

Charities, membership groups, foundations, and community programs.

Accessible program information, donation journeys, volunteer signups, and impact reporting.

Startups and SaaS companies

Software startups, B2B platforms, subscription products, and technology ventures.

Product positioning, onboarding, dashboards, billing, integrations, and an MVP roadmap.

Agencies and franchises

Marketing and creative agencies, multi-location operators, and franchise groups.

Consistent brand systems, location content, team workflows, and lead routing.

Agriculture and food production

Farms, agricultural suppliers, food processors, and agtech teams.

Product and capability information, wholesale enquiries, seasonal updates, and customer portals.

Other business types

Specialist, hybrid, and emerging business models.

A discovery-led scope based on your customers, operations, compliance needs, and growth goals.
